Experimental_dAIver 改进和增强的工作流程。

该工作流程带来了令人印象深刻的质量、及时的遵守和新的效率克里亚2涡轮将模型系列添加到您本地的 ComfyUI 设置中。它专门针对低 VRAM GPU（在 RTX 4050 6 GB 上测试）进行了优化，并具有强大的功能NdSuperLora装载机通过自动触发字处理实现无缝多 LoRA 堆叠，CacheDiT_Model_Optimizer + PathchSageAttentionKJ为了显着提高速度，直观的selectLatentSizePlus宽高比和分辨率选择器，模型采样AuraFlow具有换档控制和完整的集成SEEDVR2 视频升级器子图获得出色的 4K+ 剧照和短视频序列。该工作流程使用专用的 krea2 CLIP 类型和 qwen_image_vae 来实现最大的兼容性和质量。

1.0版本是首次公开发布，提供了一个干净、快速且高度灵活的基础，专门针对 Krea 2 Turbo（和 Base）检查点进行了调整。

要使用 Krea2，您需要最新的 ComfyUI 版本 0.25 及更高版本。

v1.0 的主要功能：

  • 完整的原生支持Krea2_Turbo_fp8mixed.safetensors以及 Winnougan 集合中的所有其他量化变体（FP8 / MXFP8 / NVFP4 / INT8 / ConvRot INT8）

  • NdSuperLora装载机（nd-超级节点）具有完整的多 LoRA 支持、自动获取触发字和干净的强度控制

  • CacheDiT_Model_Optimizer + PathchSageAttentionKJ– 两者都是可选的，但默认启用，可显着提高低 VRAM 硬件的速度，而几乎没有质量损失

  • selectLatentSizePlus- 方便的长宽比和分辨率选择器，带有摄影预设（包括黄金比例友好选项）和一键方向交换

  • 高级采样通过KSampler高级版（ER_SDE 或欧拉）+模型采样AuraFlow（推荐第 4 班）使用 Beta 或 Simple 调度程序 – 8-10 步就已经取得了优异的结果

  • 高质量解码qwen_image_vae

  • 完成SEEDVR2 视频升级器子图– 强大的基于 DiT 的升级器，可在静态图像和短视频剪辑上提供令人惊叹的高分辨率结果，并具有 Lab 色彩校正、时间设置和智能分辨率处理

  • 专业输出选项保存图像扩展和ChronoSaveForCivit（非常适合直接上传具有嵌入式元数据和工作流程的 CivitAI）

  • 自记录工作流程，包含详细的 MarkdownNote 以及所有下载链接、推荐设置和文件夹指南

所需的自定义节点

  • nd-超级节点(HenkDz) – NdSuperLoraLoader 和现代 UI 组件https://github.com/HenkDz/nd-super-nodes

  • ComfyUI-CacheDiT– CacheDiT_Model_Optimizer

  • comfyui-kjnodes– PathchSageAttentionKJ

  • 舒适型– 选择LatentSizePlushttps://github.com/MzMaXaM/ComfyUi-MzMaXaM

  • 保存图像扩展-comfyui– 保存图像扩展

  • ComfyUI-SeedVR2_VideoUpscaler– 完整的 SEEDVR2 视频升级器子图https://github.com/ainvfx/ComfyUI-SeedVR2_VideoUpscaler

重要：在安装自定义节点之前，将 ComfyUI 更新到最新版本。 Krea 2 支持和相关节点从最近的核心更新中受益匪浅。

模型和下载（确切路径）

以下列表准确说明了您需要哪些文件以及将它们放置在何处。

1. 主要扩散模型（Krea 2 Turbo FP8）：

文件：Krea2_Turbo_fp8mixed.safetensors（或您喜欢的任何其他量化变体）下载：Base 和 Turbo 的所有量化模型 (FP8 / MXFP8 / NVFP4 / INT8 / ConvRot INT8)：👉Winnougan/Krea-2-Base-Turbo-NVFP4-FP8-INT8 目标文件夹：ComfyUI/模型/diffusion_models/Krea2/（如果 Krea2 子文件夹不存在，则创建它。UNETLoader 引用此确切的路径结构。）

2. 文本编码器：

文件：qwen3vl_4b_fp8_scaled.safetensors下载： https://huggingface.co/Comfy-Org/Qwen3-VL/blob/main/text_encoders/qwen3vl_4b_fp8_scaled.safetensors 目标文件夹：ComfyUI/模型/text_encoders/

重要：在剪辑加载器节点设置类型小部件到 krea2。

3.VAE：

文件：qwen_image_vae.safetensors下载： https://huggingface.co/Comfy-Org/Qwen-Image_ComfyUI/blob/main/split_files/vae/qwen_image_vae.safetensors 目标文件夹：ComfyUI/模型/vae/

4. LoRA（对于 NdSuperLoraLoader – 完整的多 LoRA 支持）：

任何兼容的 LoRA (.safetensors)。目标文件夹：ComfyUI/模型/loras/

5. SEEDVR2 模型（用于集成升级器子图 - 可选但强烈推荐）：

  • 迪特型号：Seedvr2_ema_3b-Q8_0.gguf

  • VAE：ema_vae_fp16.safetensors

从官方 ComfyUI-SeedVR2_VideoUpscaler 存储库或 Hugging Face 下载并按照节点的安装说明进行操作。

文件夹结构概述

文本

📂 舒适UI/
├── 📂 模特/
│ ├── 📂 扩散_模型/
│ │ └── 📂 Krea2/
│ │ └── Krea2_Turbo_fp8mixed.safetensors
│ ├── 📂 文本编码器/
│ │ └── qwen3vl_4b_fp8_scaled.safetensors
│ ├── 📂腿/
│ │ └── qwen_image_vae.safetensors
│ └── 📂 洛拉斯/
│ └── （这里是你的 LoRA）

推荐设置

  • 采样器：er_sde（推荐）或 euler

  • 调度程序：beta（推荐）或简单

  • 步骤：8–10（Turbo 模型以非常低的步数提供卓越的质量）

  • CFG 规模：1.0

  • 转变（模型采样AuraFlow）：4–7（大多数情况下 4 是最佳位置）

  • 分辨率和纵横比：可自由选择通过selectLatentSizePlus– 包括“2:3 标准摄影”、许多其他标准比例和高达 2048 像素的分辨率。使用交换方向用于即时纵向/横向翻转。支持批量大小。

  • 洛拉的优势：堆叠多个模型时，从每个 LoRA 0.6–1.0 开始。

紧凑的设置表也直接嵌入到工作流程的 MarkdownNote 节点中，以供快速参考。

如何使用工作流程

  1. 在 ComfyUI 中加载 JSON。

  2. 在“宽高比”和“分辨率”中选择您想要的宽高比和分辨率selectLatentSizePlus节点（启用交换方向如果需要的话）。

  3. 在 Positive Prompt 节点中输入您的提示（NdSuperLoraLoader 自动处理来自 LoRA 的触发词）。

  4. 将一个或多个兼容的 LoRA 加载到 NdSuperLoraLoader 中。

  5. 产生。该工作流程非常高效地生成高质量的基础图像。

  6. （可选）运行集成的 SEEDVR2 放大子图，在静态图像或短视频序列上获得漂亮的高分辨率结果。

  7. 使用 SaveImageExtended 和/或 ChronoSaveForCivit 进行完整的文件名控制、元数据嵌入和 CivitAI 就绪导出。

您可以完全绕过或静音升频器组以进行快速测试。该工作流程还可以与其他 Krea 2 检查点配合使用 - 只需更改 UNETLoader 中的文件名即可。如果遇到兼容性问题，可以单独禁用 CacheDiT 和 SageAttention（它们是可选的速度增强器）。

这是一个干净、快速且强大的基础，专门针对新的韩国 2 涡轮 FP8模型 - 即使在普通硬件上也非常适合快速迭代、创造性的多 LoRA 组合和高质量的最终输出。

非常感谢温努甘用于创建和量化优秀的 Krea 2 模型，并亨克兹(nd-super-nodes)、CacheDiT 团队、kjnodes、MzMaXaM、ainvfx (SeedVR2) 以及 SaveImageExtended 和 ChronoSaveForCivit 的作者使这些先进的低 VRAM 工作流程成为可能。

如果您有疑问或想分享您的结果 - 我很高兴在评论中收到您的来信。享受工作流程！

o.en:
A refined and enhanced workflow by Experimental_dAIver.

This workflow brings the impressive quality, prompt adherence and efficiency of the newKrea 2 Turbomodel family into your local ComfyUI setup. It is specifically optimized for low-VRAM GPUs (tested on RTX 4050 6 GB) and features the powerfulNdSuperLoraLoaderfor seamless multi-LoRA stacking with automatic trigger-word handling,CacheDiT_Model_Optimizer + PathchSageAttentionKJfor noticeable speed gains, the intuitiveselectLatentSizePlusaspect-ratio and resolution selector,ModelSamplingAuraFlowwith shift control, and a complete integratedSEEDVR2 Video Upscaler Subgraphfor outstanding 4K+ stills and short video sequences. The workflow uses the dedicated krea2 CLIP type together with qwen_image_vae for maximum compatibility and quality.

Version 1.0is the initial public release and delivers a clean, fast and highly flexible base specifically tuned for Krea 2 Turbo (and Base) checkpoints.

To use Krea2, you need the latest ComfyUI versions 0.25 and later.

Key features in v1.0:

  • Full native support forKrea2_Turbo_fp8mixed.safetensorsand all other quantized variants (FP8 / MXFP8 / NVFP4 / INT8 / ConvRot INT8) from the Winnougan collection

  • NdSuperLoraLoader(nd-super-nodes) with full multi-LoRA support, auto-fetch trigger words and clean strength control

  • CacheDiT_Model_Optimizer + PathchSageAttentionKJ– both optional but enabled by default for significant speed improvements on low-VRAM hardware with almost no quality loss

  • selectLatentSizePlus– convenient aspect-ratio and resolution selector with photography presets (including golden-ratio-friendly options) and one-click orientation swap

  • Advanced sampling viaKSamplerAdvanced(ER_SDE or Euler) +ModelSamplingAuraFlow(shift 4 recommended) with Beta or Simple scheduler – excellent results already at 8–10 steps

  • High-quality decoding withqwen_image_vae

  • CompleteSEEDVR2 Video Upscaler Subgraph– powerful DiT-based upscaler that delivers stunning high-resolution results on still images and short video clips, with Lab color correction, temporal settings and intelligent resolution handling

  • Professional output options withSaveImageExtendedandChronoSaveForCivit(perfect for direct CivitAI uploads with embedded metadata and workflow)

  • Self-documenting workflow containing a detailed MarkdownNote with all download links, recommended settings and folder guidance

Required Custom Nodes

  • nd-super-nodes(HenkDz) – NdSuperLoraLoader and modern UI componentshttps://github.com/HenkDz/nd-super-nodes

  • ComfyUI-CacheDiT– CacheDiT_Model_Optimizer

  • comfyui-kjnodes– PathchSageAttentionKJ

  • ComfyUi-MzMaXaM– selectLatentSizePlushttps://github.com/MzMaXaM/ComfyUi-MzMaXaM

  • save-image-extended-comfyui– SaveImageExtended

  • ComfyUI-SeedVR2_VideoUpscaler– full SEEDVR2 Video Upscaler subgraphhttps://github.com/ainvfx/ComfyUI-SeedVR2_VideoUpscaler

Important:Update ComfyUI to the latest version before installing the custom nodes. Krea 2 support and the involved nodes benefit greatly from recent core updates.

Models & Downloads (exact paths)

The following list explains exactly which files you need and where to place them.

1. Main Diffusion Model (Krea 2 Turbo FP8):

File:Krea2_Turbo_fp8mixed.safetensors (or any other quant variant you prefer)Download:All quantized models (FP8 / MXFP8 / NVFP4 / INT8 / ConvRot INT8) for both Base and Turbo: 👉Winnougan/Krea-2-Base-Turbo-NVFP4-FP8-INT8 Target folder:ComfyUI/models/diffusion_models/Krea2/(Create the Krea2 subfolder if it does not exist. The UNETLoader references this exact path structure.)

2. Text Encoder:

File:qwen3vl_4b_fp8_scaled.safetensorsDownload: https://huggingface.co/Comfy-Org/Qwen3-VL/blob/main/text_encoders/qwen3vl_4b_fp8_scaled.safetensors Target folder:ComfyUI/models/text_encoders/

Important:In theCLIPLoadernode set thetypewidget to krea2.

3. VAE:

File:qwen_image_vae.safetensorsDownload: https://huggingface.co/Comfy-Org/Qwen-Image_ComfyUI/blob/main/split_files/vae/qwen_image_vae.safetensors Target folder:ComfyUI/models/vae/

4. LoRAs (for NdSuperLoraLoader – full multi-LoRA support):

Any compatible LoRAs (.safetensors).Target folder:ComfyUI/models/loras/

5. SEEDVR2 Models (for the integrated upscaler subgraph – optional but highly recommended):

  • DiT Model:seedvr2_ema_3b-Q8_0.gguf

  • VAE:ema_vae_fp16.safetensors

Download from the official ComfyUI-SeedVR2_VideoUpscaler repository or Hugging Face and follow the node’s installation instructions.

Folder Structure Overview

text

📂 ComfyUI/
├── 📂 models/
│ ├── 📂 diffusion_models/
│ │ └── 📂 Krea2/
│ │ └── Krea2_Turbo_fp8mixed.safetensors
│ ├── 📂 text_encoders/
│ │ └── qwen3vl_4b_fp8_scaled.safetensors
│ ├── 📂 vae/
│ │ └── qwen_image_vae.safetensors
│ └── 📂 loras/
│ └── (your LoRAs here)

Recommended Settings

  • Sampler:er_sde (recommended) or euler

  • Scheduler:beta (recommended) or simple

  • Steps:8–10 (Turbo model delivers excellent quality at very low step counts)

  • CFG Scale:1.0

  • Shift (ModelSamplingAuraFlow):4–7 (4 is the sweet spot in most cases)

  • Resolution & Aspect Ratio:Freely selectable viaselectLatentSizePlus– includes “2:3 Standard Photography”, many other standard ratios and resolutions up to 2048 px. Useswap_orientationfor instant portrait/landscape flip. Batch size supported.

  • LoRA Strengths:Start with 0.6–1.0 per LoRA when stacking multiple models.

A compact settings table is also embedded directly in the workflow’s MarkdownNote node for quick reference.

How to use the workflow

  1. Load the JSON in ComfyUI.

  2. Select your desired aspect ratio and resolution in theselectLatentSizePlusnode (enableswap_orientationif needed).

  3. Enter your prompt in the Positive Prompt node (the NdSuperLoraLoader automatically handles trigger words from your LoRAs).

  4. Load one or more compatible LoRAs into the NdSuperLoraLoader.

  5. Generate. The workflow produces a high-quality base image extremely efficiently.

  6. (Optional) Run the integrated SEEDVR2 upscaler subgraph for beautiful high-resolution results on still images or short video sequences.

  7. Use SaveImageExtended and/or ChronoSaveForCivit for full filename control, metadata embedding and CivitAI-ready exports.

You can bypass or mute the upscaler group completely for fast testing. The workflow also works with other Krea 2 checkpoints – simply change the filename in the UNETLoader. CacheDiT and SageAttention can be disabled individually if you ever encounter compatibility issues (they are optional speed boosters).

This is a clean, fast and powerful base specifically tuned for the newKrea 2 Turbo FP8model — perfect for quick iterations, creative multi-LoRA compositions and high-quality final outputs even on modest hardware.

Huge thanks toWinnouganfor creating and quantizing the excellent Krea 2 models, and toHenkDz(nd-super-nodes), the CacheDiT team, kjnodes, MzMaXaM, ainvfx (SeedVR2), as well as the authors of SaveImageExtended and ChronoSaveForCivit for making these advanced, low-VRAM workflows possible.

If you have questions or want to share your results — I’m happy to hear from you in the comments. Enjoy the workflow!
